goal: Get data/tfrecord.py working (the README targets Python 2.7 and TensorFlow 1.x; any environment where the script runs unmodified in behaviour is fine). It must convert the bundled images data/images/im_0..im_3.jpg, listed in an index file given via -idx (lines like 'im_0.jpg<TAB>3:1 865:1 2:1'), into a .tfrecords file in the -tfs directory using -im data/images/ -cls 11166 -one True. Each record must contain the image bytes, a 11166-float label vector and the image name.
check: The hidden test generates its own index file for the four bundled images, runs tfrecord.py, and checks that the output TFRecord holds 4 records with the expected names, JPEG data and label vectors of plausible size.
